messages:
Alex: quick check — PR #14222 has LGTM from product and fixes a regression in the tokenizer. CI is stuck on the macOS matrix with a flaky test. We have a deploy freeze starting at 22:00 UTC; do we try to land before that or wait?

deploy-bot: heads up — scheduled deploy freeze starts 22:00 UTC for infra maintenance (duration ~2h). No infrastructure-affecting merges after 21:30 UTC without ops sign-off.

Jen: I can give final eyes in ~10m. which test is failing?

Alex: failing snippet below from the macOS runner (same flaky seen before):
```
FAIL tests/unit/test_file_watcher.py::FileWatcherTest::test_detects_rename
E   AssertionError: Expected event 'moved' but got 'changed'
```

Sam: that's the FileWatcherTest flake. Rerun usually clears it. I'll trigger a retry now: `ci retry 14222`

Jen: ok. if rerun passes, are we aiming to merge straight to main before freeze or promote via staging/canary? last-minute merges are risky.

Priya: +1 to canary staging first. If staging is green for 30m we can promote. avoids a rollback during freeze window.

Mike: ops note — this PR is app code only, no infra. Still prefer to avoid merging within the final hour before freeze. If you absolutely must, we need an ops +1.

Sam: rerun 1 -> passed, rerun 2 -> still failing. queueing a third. status: 2/3 green so far.

Alex: thanks. plan suggestion: wait for next rerun. if all green before 21:00 UTC, merge to staging/canary and hold promotion until 30m of stability. if not green by 21:00, hold until freeze ends. @Jen can you approve on green?

Jen: yup — I'll approve as soon as the final run is green. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: reminder — merges after 21:30 UTC will be deferred until freeze completion unless force-merged with ops approval.

Alex: sounds good. I'll monitor the third rerun and update here. ping me if you see regressions in canary once we promote.

Sam: third rerun is green now. tagging @Jen for final approve.

Jen: Approved and merging to staging. will watch canary for 30m then promote if stable. :eyes:

Alex: merging now. thanks everyone.

Priya: nice. will watch logs and rollback if any anomalies.

Mike: noted, ops on standby for rollback if needed.

Alex: closing the loop — landed at 20:42 UTC, canary stable after 35m, promoted at 21:17 UTC before freeze window. all good. :thumbsup:
